India Expands Defense and Strategic Ties with Japan and Malaysia

India has recently engaged in significant diplomatic and defense-related discussions with both Japan and Malaysia. With Japan, the focus has been on expanding strategic cooperation in areas like artificial intelligence, energy resilience, and supply chains, including a first-ever defense co-development project. Concurrently, India and Malaysia have reinforced their maritime security collaboration, reviewing military cooperation and agreeing to enhance joint efforts in defense industry, cybersecurity, and disaster relief.
